dropped.claim: The thesis claims cash covers less than eight months of burn, but this calculation misuses an annual rate. Cash of $63.0M against operating cash outflow of -$98.6M for FY2025 provides approximately 7.7 months of runway based on the full-year burn, not a forward-looking monthly rate. The company also held $246.6M in cash, cash equivalents, and investments in U.S. Treasury securities as of December 31, 2025—nearly 4x the $63.0M cash figure cited—providing substantially longer runway than claimed.
